Plan ahead your staying in Jeddah

Traditional Food 

Saudi Arabian traditional food reflects the country’s rich cultural heritage shaped by its history, geography, and the diverse of trade and pilgrimage. Each region in Saudi Arabia offers a flavorful journey through its traditional food, reflecting the importance of hospitality, and represent traditions of communal gatherings and family ties in Arab culture.

 

Family Fun

Exploring history reveals ancient rock art, historic sites and key Islamic landmarks in Mecca and Madinah. Jeddah is a vital port city on the Red Sea acting as a gateway for pilgrims, offering insights of its heritage as a strategic hub for trade and cultural exchange.

Historical Riches

The magic of Al-Balad site, “Historic Jeddah”, is not limited to the heritage value surrounding you, but also to the unique location being twenty minutes away from the best shopping experiences and international restaurants, and another twenty minutes away from the largest and most important car race in the world; the STC Formula 1 Saudi Grand Prix.

 

Adventurous Escapes

Explore the adventure of the unique blend of urban vibrancy and natural beauty in Jeddah, that offers adventurous escapes for travelers seeking both excitement and relaxation. From diving into vibrant coral reefs and enjoying water activities to experiencing the thrill of desert escapades and cultural explorations.
